Load cell: The load cell is a single point aluminium load cell type PA06 manufactured by Beijing True-Tec Co., Ltd. Page 2. This certificate includes 3 pages. --- **OIML Certificate No R76/2006-GB1-09.01** Technical data: The internal power supply unit supplies 9 Vac to the instrument.
